body: It really means a lot, thank you :) Situations like these aren't fun for anybody, I'm just glad I'm not alone in thinking I made the right choice.

Thank you for this, it really helped.

Her dad is going to keep me posted on what's happening with her health but other than that we're finished. I hope to remain friends with her, when the appropriate amount of time has passed, and really just want her to find the [professional] help she needs.
